messages:
anna (sec): quick heads-up: last night's base-image rebuild failed to sign 3/12 artifacts. saw a KMS permission error in the cosign step, blocking promotion to staging. anyone on call?

cj (oncall): on it. can you paste the exact error from the pipeline logs?

anna (sec): here you go:
```
Error: cosign: failed to sign image
cause: rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc="key not permitted for signing: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeyVersions/3"
```

ben (infra): that reads like an IAM binding change on the key. did we run any TF that touched iam_member on the keyring last night?

maria (sre): i noticed a terraform apply from @devops at 02:14 that touched iam_bindings on a couple of keyrings. could be related.

anna (sec): proposed emergency steps: 1) pause the scheduled rebuilds so we don't keep queueing failures 2) fallback to the alternative signing key (images-alt) for immediate promotion 3) open an incident and notify audit/compliance 4) run an inventory to find other pipelines referencing the old keyversion.

devsec: +1. audit log shows the cosign client attempted to use serviceAccount:signer-service-account@rwd-prod. KMS IAM currently allows image-signer@internal only. mismatch in allowed principals.

cj (oncall): can we patch the rebuild pipeline to use the alt key via env override? i can push a hotfix if we agree. will that require additional RBAC to impersonate the service account?

ben (infra): the alt key exists but the pipeline runner still needs 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign' on the alt key. i can impersonate if someone with iam privileges approves an emergency grant. @anna can you trigger approval?

anna (sec): @ops-bot please create an incident ticket named image-sign-failure-1755554321 and page sec oncall.

ops-bot: INC-4521 created: image-sign-failure-1755554321. assignees: cj (oncall), anna (sec).

maria (sre): when we patch, let's also emit structured audit entries from the signing step: {service: cosign, image: gcr, key: name, key_version: x, signer: sa, op: sign}. current logs are unstructured text blobs and make triage slow.

devsec: also add a deterministic artifact label for the keyversion used, so we can correlate signature -> KMS keyversion during postmortem.

cj (oncall): hotfix pushed to pipeline with env override to use images-alt key. kicking a one-off rebuild now.

(cj (oncall)): rebuild logs: `Signed image: gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-20` — success on the one-off.

anna (sec): :thumbsup: good mitigation. next actions: - run TF plan to see who changed the original key binding - run a query across cloud audit logs for 'PermissionDenied' KMS errors in signing pipelines - schedule a short postmortem. i'll own the audit query and initial timeline.

ben (infra): opened a revert PR to roll back the iam change until we have a clean playbook. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/1792

anna (sec): postmortem agenda: timeline, root cause (accidental iam change during TF refactor), blast radius (which pipelines/artifacts affected), detection gaps, and mitigation checklist (canary signing, alerting on KMS denied, TF gating). propose 09:30 tomorrow.

devsec: follow-ups: (1) add a canary job that signs a small artifact on each key rotation/deploy and fails the deploy if signing fails, (2) create an alert for `cosign: failed to sign` or KMS PermissionDenied with runbook link, (3) bake structured audit logs from signer service.

maria (sre): i'll add the alert + runbook to the incidents channel and make sure it's tied to INC-4521.

anna (sec): i'll run the inventory query now to find other pipelines referencing the old keyversion and paste results here.

ben (infra): thanks. once the revert PR is approved we'll reconcile TF state, then we can rotate to a new key with a well-documented signer SA and test harness.

anna (sec): keeping this thread as the canonical audit trail for the incident. tagging @legal for compliance visibility — we may need a short compliance note depending on residency of signed artifacts.

legal: thanks for the ping. please add a short summary of affected artifacts and any customer-facing exposure once available.

anna (sec): will do. updating INC-4521 with timeline + mitigation steps.

(END)
